title: Modularize NAT gateway lifecycle and plan AWS provider upgrade
creator: Riley Chen
description: Refactor our networking Terraform to isolate NAT gateway lifecycle and decouple ephemeral address management from VPC module abstractions, then perform a controlled upgrade of the AWS provider to the latest v5.x series. Current problems: long terraform plans caused by NAT recreation, EIP drift, and provider deprecations that block CI. Goal: reduce plan churn, enable parallel stable updates across regions, and complete provider upgrade with zero-downtime for production networking.
acceptance_criteria: Core networking modules split into 'vpc-core' and 'nat-lifecycle' with clear inputs/outputs
Terraform plans in prod-staging apply without recreating NATs when no config changes are present
Automated CI runs against a test workspace (eu-west-1) complete with provider v5 and no breaking resource replacements
Provider upgrade rollout documented and a rollback path validated
Infra team runbook updated and one canary region completed end-to-end
rollout_plan: 1) Create feature branch and new modules; 2) Run full Terraform plan in isolated test workspace; 3) Apply to staging test cluster (canary region); 4) Monitor drift and traffic metrics for 48h; 5) Gradually roll provider upgrade region-by-region with a single-module canary; 6) Finalize and tag release.
migration_steps: Introduce nat-lifecycle module and migrate existing NAT resources with state move (terraform state mv) in test workspace
Add explicit EIP resource ownership to nat-lifecycle to prevent name collisions
Pin provider v4.x to a transition branch and run compatibility tests
Upgrade provider to v5.x in a feature environment and run full plan/apply
Run cross-account/state validation and update remote state locks and backends if needed
Merge and roll through regions according to rollout_plan
rollback_plan: Revert provider version in Terraform config and re-apply using saved state snapshots. If module split causes unexpected replacement, restore previous state using state snapshots and coordinate short maintenance window for affected region.
